newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian capital experiences another power outage.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian capital experiences another power outage.

text.p: A faulty power cable cut the supply of electricity to several parts of the Malaysian capital on Tuesday, the Bernama news agency said.
The disruption, which began at about 1100 local time (0300 GMT), was resolved by 1530 (0730 GMT) after affecting nearly three quarters of the capital, the agency said.
A spokesman for national power utility Tenaga Nasional Bhd was quoted as saying that the fault was with a cable in a main intake station in Kuala Lumpur.
The last power outage in the capital was on November 26, when another faulty cable cut the supply to the central business district.
